SELECT CURRENT_CATALOG AS database, CURRENT_SCHEMA AS schema, SESSION_USER AS login

SELECT * FROM (
SELECT current_database() AS current_database, n.nspname,c.relname,a.attname,a.atttypid,a.attnotnull
OR (t.typtype = 'd' AND t.typnotnull) AS attnotnull,a.atttypmod,a.attlen,t.typtypmod,
row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.attrelid ORDER BY a.attnum) AS attnum,
nullif(a.attidentity, '') as attidentity,nullif(a.attgenerated, '') as attgenerated,
pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(def.adbin, def.adrelid) AS adsrc,dsc.description,t.typbasetype,t.typtype
FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace n
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON (c.relnamespace = n.oid)
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a ON (a.attrelid=c.oid)
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_type t ON (a.atttypid = t.oid)
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attrdef def ON (a.attrelid=def.adrelid AND a.attnum = def.adnum)
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_description dsc ON (c.oid=dsc.objoid AND a.attnum = dsc.objsubid)
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class dc ON (dc.oid=dsc.classoid AND dc.relname='pg_class')
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace dn ON (dc.relnamespace=dn.oid AND dn.nspname='pg_catalog')
WHERE c.relkind in ('r','p','v','f','m') and a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
AND n.nspname LIKE 'public' AND c.relname LIKE 'users') c WHERE true
AND attname LIKE '%' ORDER BY nspname,c.relname,attnum

SELECT t.typname,t.oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_type t
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON (t.typnamespace = n.oid)
WHERE n.nspname != 'pg_toast'
AND (t.typrelid = 0 OR (SELECT c.relkind = 'c' FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c WHERE c.oid = t.typrelid))
AND has_type_privilege(t.oid, 'USAGE') ORDER BY t.oid
SELECT conrelid, bool_and(indnullsnotdistinct) FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_index i ON i.indexrelid=c.conindid GROUP BY conrelid ORDER BY conrelid
SELECT collname, pg_catalog.pg_collation_is_visible(oid) FROM pg_catalog.pg_collation ORDER BY oid
SELECT nspname FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace WHERE NOT pg_is_other_temp_schema(oid) AND oid <> pg_my_temp_schema() ORDER BY nspname
SELECT pg_catalog.pg_database.datname FROM pg_catalog.pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()
SELECT pg_catalog.pg_database.* FROM pg_catalog.pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()
SELECT v.*, s.* FROM LATERAL pg_catalog.version() v CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.current_setting('SERVER_VERSION_NUM') s
